text.en: Several pet owners praise the store staff, noting that assistants like Gracie and Elka are welcoming, patient, and knowledgeable about pet nutrition and grooming. However, two reviewers noted customer service lapses, including an unhelpful attitude regarding product availability.

title.en: Speciality pet food and store selection

text.en: Customers appreciate the curated selection of wholesome pet food, raw diets, and the treat bar setup for dogs and cats. Conversely, critical feedback points out limited feline-specific grooming shampoos and occasional card reader payment equipment failures at checkout.

Reviewers highlight positive experiences with both professional grooming appointments and the DIY dog wash stations. Pet owners specifically commend careful feline coat trims and neat canine grooming, noting that pets emerge well groomed and relaxed.

q.en: What types of pet food are sold at this shop?

a.en: The shop offers specialised healthy foods, natural treats, and dietary supplements for both canine and feline pets.

q.en: Are grooming services available on site?

a.en: Yes, the location provides professional grooming by appointment as well as self-serve pet washing facilities.

q.en: Can cats be groomed at this location?

a.en: Reviewers specifically highlight positive cat trimming and grooming experiences with the resident pet stylist.

q.en: Where is the shop located in Squaw Peak Plaza?

a.en: The shop is situated in Squaw Peak Plaza along North 16th Street, with ample plaza parking available.
